title: Your first job
assist_caption: I'll take it this time. Watch what I do.

call.caption: Your first job: take her across to the lesson dock. She's yours. Keep the bow on a tree on the far shore.
call.retry: Small moves on the tiller. Pick one tree and keep the bow pointed at it.

call.caption: Let the mainsheet out until the front of the sail starts to flap.
call.retry: Ease the main a bit more, until the front edge shivers.
call.ok: See it flap? That's too far out.

call.caption: Now pull it in just until the flapping stops. That's trimmed.
call.retry: Bring the main back in, a little at a time, until it goes quiet.

call.caption: Turn toward the wind, slowly, until the sails start to flap, then bear off a touch.
call.retry: Gently toward the wind. When the front of the sails shivers, turn back a little.
call.ok: That's close-hauled: as close to the wind as she sails.

call.caption: Ready about? Push the tiller away from you and hold it. Bow through the wind.
call.retry: Tiller over, away from you, and keep it there until the sails fill on the other side.
call.ok: Through she goes. That's a tack.

call.caption: To stop, point her straight into the wind and let the sails flap.
call.retry: Head right into the wind and hold her there. The sails go quiet and she slows down.
call.ok: Job done: steer, trim, tack, stop. Next time you'll take her off the dock yourself.
